integrity: Scientific claims supported by an exact complete type recurrence, independently checked boundary examples, and an unbounded-index Ehrenfeucht-Fraisse argument. No independent mathematical audit or exhaustive publication-priority clearance has been performed.
limitations: Ordinary first-order quantifier rank four only, with pure undirected adjacency/equality; graph family GP(n,2) for n>=5. Orbit-reduced exact finite checks through n=24, independent full-tuples check through n=16, and proved cyclic-gap transfer for all n>=24. No result for larger ranks or arbitrary generalized Petersen step sizes.
title: Ten four-round theories of generalized Petersen graphs with step two
